integerization.depot_allocation: Hamilton largest-remainder allocation of the instance EV target across depots using ev_share*candidate_total_d; ties by depot_id
integerization.reason: preserves the closest attainable instance-level proportion and prevents small-depot independent rounding from changing the denominator

scientific_claim_alignment: The five levels identify whether time-varying carbon intensity acts mainly through charging-time relocation when EV capacity is scarce, then through route/type reassignment as replaceable EV capacity expands. The output must therefore report route/type changes and charging-time changes alongside cost and emissions, not merely test whether more EVs lower emissions.
table_comparability_note: Use one row per target share and group columns by customer count and region/depot-count. The treatment is the same instance-level EV share, while total fleet is held at the instance-specific candidate vector. Report available EV/CV and actually dispatched EV/CV separately. Keep infeasible or not-certified rows with status and violation reason; do not delete them or relax payload, time windows, battery, charger count/power, or service horizon.
unit_definition: EV available vehicles divided by the instance candidate total fleet; depot integers are allocated by Hamilton largest remainder
